name: Photoreal studio portraits
tagline: Anti-AI-slop portrait prompts for Gemini and GPT image models — real camera + real lens + film grain + asymmetry beat any glossy commercial default.
description: How to prompt an image model so it produces a portrait that reads as a photograph of a real person, not as AI. Covers master-portrait anchors, location-aware plates, close-ups, and the negative-prompt cluster that suppresses the beauty-filter default.
